purpose: Remove historical bulk from the active PPO checkout while preserving its Git history and all existing local files. No history rewrite or local experiment deletion.
recovery: Use git show SOURCE_REVISION:PATH to restore exact archived bytes from Git history. The original working copy and dirty or untracked experiments remain untouched.
recovery_revision_note: Existing origin/main ancestor; every archived blob verified identical to the measured task revision. Normal branch rebases do not remove this history.
